networks.name: fixbay_repair_assistant
networks.description: Diagnose broken electronics and appliances, check spare-part inventory & safety hazards, calculate CO2 & dollar savings, and reserve a community repair workbench.
sample_queries: My espresso machine has low pressure and leaks near the portafilter. Is it safe and worth repairing?
Check spare parts for a mechanical keyboard USB-C port repair and reserve one for me.
Which Saturday workbench slots have a micro-soldering station available?
Reserve the 58mm silicone group gasket and help me book a Saturday afternoon bench.

peer_policy.note: Runs a 4-agent local specialist network with verified page-local workshop actions and an inspectable live TraceBus.
